adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, `bookingCalendarReference` is changed from a single `.find(...)` to `.filter(...)`, and the code now loops `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`. However, inside the recurring-cancellation branch (`if (bookingToDelete.eventType?.recurringEvent && ... allRemainingBookings)`), it still selects only one calendar reference per updated booking via `updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"))`. In a multi-reference world (multiple `_calendar` references per booking), this will delete at most the first calendar event reference per booking and ignore the others. Additionally, because this recurring deletion logic sits inside the new outer loop over `bookingCalendarReference`, it can be executed multiple times, leading to duplicate delete attempts for the same found reference(s). This matches the finding's described behavior.
